meta.title: Savings and every figure stay the same after the close
gaps: The available read-backs do not expose savings or every bid figure, and assertion operations cannot compare post-close values with values captured before the close.
The setup provides a closed event but does not provide a six-minute-window-specific state.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where two QA vendors bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds; “bid count” equals 2; “participants” is not empty.

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that the read succeeds; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “bid count” equals 2; “participants” is not empty; the read succeeds; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty; the read succeeds.
